messages:
mina: heads-up from the opal-int8-ptq onboarding sweep. strict funcall pass fell from 99.5% -> 88.2 on long-prefix streaming + retry matrix.

oscar: yikes. what's the failure mode?

mina: captured a streaming replay where a UTF-8 BOM appears mid-json, sometimes split across chunks. strict parsers choke on the stray BOM or the replacement char when partial bytes are emitted. occurs only with retry-on-early-eos enabled.

lia: example raw capture (trimmed). note the lone 0xEF byte emitted between key and value in one chunk, then retried chunk appends 0xBB 0xBF, producing a mid-json BOM: this breaks strict readers.

```
{"tool":"upsert","args":{"items":[{"id":5,"label":"todo"}]}}
...chunk1 bytes end: ... 0x3a 0x20 0xEF
...chunk2 start: 0xBB 0xBF 0x22 0x7b ...
// combined -> key value becomes: : \uFEFF"{ ... } which is invalid for our strict schema checker
```

oscar: so the chunk boundary split turns into a BOM when chunks get concatenated on retry. other variants/quant levels ok?

mina: correct. zephyr2-int4 and raven-lite behave fine. opal-int8-ptq and a mirror-int8 show the split emission under certain kernels (Ampere fallback seen).

lia: any sign of decoder LUT mismatches like earlier cases?

mina: token hex shows an extra 0xEF emitted where reference emits 0x20; looks like decoder table or kernel fallback that maps a multi-byte sequence incorrectly when state is sliced.

dev-bot: Canary recipe queued: replay-opal-bom-split, targets: opal-int8-ptq sharded/non-sharded, mirror-int8.

infra-bot: Canary job created: CCI-10021. logs: https://ci.redwood/cci/10021.

mina: quick mitigation tested: canary-only sanitizer that removes BOMs and U+FFFD replacement chars before JSON parse. pass rate goes to 97.6 for the failing set, but this is a mask.

oscar: agreed not to ship sanitizer broadly. immediate actions?

lia: propose:
- block opal-int8-ptq sharded profile on Dedicated until root cause found
- add schema-delta alert: trigger if any quant variant drops > 2% vs baseline on golden sweep
- add idempotency token for funcall events + 250ms router dedupe window to avoid duplicates when retries happen mid-stream
- add a tokenizer/decoder CI test that simulates chunk-splits of multi-byte UTF-8 sequences to catch partial-emits on quant kernels
- run focused canary CCI-10021 and collect decoder dumps + kernel fallback traces

mina: i'll own repro/root-cause triage (collect decoder LUTs, logits around emit, and kernel flags). ETA EOD tomorrow.

oscar: i'll draft the patch to add idempotency header in the router; lia can help wire dedupe.

infra-bot: Created tickets: RWI-3001 (block opal-int8-ptq sharded), RWI-3002 (schema-delta alert), RWI-3003 (funcall idempotency + dedupe). Links: https://tracker.redwood/RWI-3001, https://tracker.redwood/RWI-3002, https://tracker.redwood/RWI-3003.

lia: small unit-test idea: feed the tokenizer a sequence that encodes as 0xEF 0xBB 0xBF and verify no build path emits partial 0xEF at a chunk boundary under quant compile. wire into quant compile CI.

mina: for customers, short-term workaround is per-route postproc toggle to enable BOM-strip; i'll prepare a playbook for routes ingesting pasted content (transcripts).

oscar: good. perf note: BOM-strip adds ~0.3ms in our simple bench. include that in the playbook.

mina: thanks all  will update when canary finishes or if we have a root cause.
